milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining oak_log blocks causes them to drop as oak_log items into the player's inventory. Checking for min_count=1 verifies the player has successfully mined at least one oak log, proving they can harvest wood. We intentionally keep this at 1 (not 6) because a player may mine logs incrementally and place them as they go — they may never hold 6 simultaneously. The bridge milestone separately verifies enough material was gathered and used.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind=block) because building a bridge means placing solid blocks over the water gap. The river spans z=5 to z=10 (spawn-relative, 6 blocks wide) after widening to prevent sprint-jumping. We check for oak_log blocks in a generous box: x=[-5,5] covers multiple possible bridge paths, y=[-1,1] allows placement at water surface or slightly above. min_count=6 ensures a complete spanning bridge (one block per z-coordinate). Only oak_log is checked because no crafting table is provided in the scene, making direct log placement the simplest and most likely strategy.
